openings.claim: Size-dependent allowance error and customer geometry mismatch are distinct hypotheses; combining calibration and geometry confirmation may improve both.
openings.discriminator: Repeatable signed error by size supports allowance; clustering by operator/grain/design weakens it. Reference success but customer failure at similar dimensions and different corners supports geometry. Both interventions outperforming either supports interaction.
openings.probe: Obtain six customers' dimensions/corners, prioritizing nominal-only orders. Compare current, geometry-only, calibration-only and combined offcut mockups. Sew first cover per size before bulk cutting; validate affected cards. Record cut/sewn dimensions, confounders, stage times and reference/customer placement. Check supported pocket revisions for appearance, removability and wash survival.
openings.uncertainty: Causes remain unestablished; two corner-associated failures and early covers are insufficient proof. Customer accuracy, representativeness and trial effort remain uncertain.

openings.claim: Two-axis wash compensation combined with grain/print-constrained nesting may preserve washed fit within purchased stock.
openings.discriminator: Compare current/compensated patterns crossed with current/revised nesting; joint success must preserve fit and area waste together.
openings.fit: Conditional preservation; retain ordered design orientation and sizes.
openings.probe: Measure retained samples along both axes through five wash cycles; calculate layout area waste before cutting/re-cutting. Verify compensated sewn fit, removability and wash survival.
openings.uncertainty: Sample representativeness, feasible layouts and added work time remain unknown; weight-estimated waste does not establish area compliance.

decision: Run bounded probes using existing machines within 350 units and three weeks. Release layouts only within 8% area waste using purchased cloth. Measure all 40: at least 38 first-placement fits, every ordered design, median total work <=32 minutes. No success yet established.
